name: Society Records
install: sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq postgresql postgresql-contrib >/dev/null && (sudo pg_ctlcluster 16 main start || sudo service postgresql start || true) && sudo -u postgres psql -tc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='society'" | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE USER society WITH PASSWORD 'society_dev' SUPERUSER;" && sudo -u postgres psql -tc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='society_records'" | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE society_records OWNER society;" && npm install && cp -n .env.example .env || true && npx prisma db push && npm run db:seed
start: pg_isready || sudo pg_ctlcluster 16 main start || sudo service postgresql start; npm run dev
